title: DJ Dave - Stand by Me (Radio Version) (2003)

lines.l: When the night has come, and the land is dark, and the moon is the only light we'll see.
No I won't be afraid, no I won't be afraid
Just as long as you stand, stand by me
So darling, darling stand by me, oh stand by me, oh stand
Stand by, stand by, stand by
When the night has come, and the land is dark, and the moon is the only light we'll see.
Just as long as you can
Stand up, stand up, stand up
Hiding from the truth I can't transform
